comparison.objective: Grate cheese while holding the grater steady; candidate separates existing media from finished parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-controlled reciprocating abrasion against a perforated face versus pouring and agitation that induces free-body passage through screen apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Required grated mass produced and tools released versus ≥98% preexisting media recovered with all washers retained and no loss.
comparison.reason: Both use perforated tools, but grating transforms material through cutting while the candidate classifies intact bodies by passage.
